01.q: How is the price of a build set?
01.a: Scope and complexity set the published range: what gets designed, engineered and integrated, and how much logic, how many templates, states and roles. Content readiness, brand readiness and timeline adjust it; integrations and performance targets are confirmed with you in scope review before the proposal fixes one figure.

02.a: No hidden fees. All figures exclude VAT at {vatRate}%. Renewals, paid third-party tools and channels like SMS are billed only if your scope actually uses them, and a maintenance plan is billed, monthly or yearly, only if you choose one.

03.q: What does the payment schedule look like?
03.a: Three payments: {paymentStart} to start, {paymentMilestone} at {milestoneTrigger}, and {paymentFinal} before production launch. Code, designs and accounts pass to you at final payment.

04.q: Can I extend the build later?
04.a: Yes. Every build is engineered to grow. Authentication, payments or dashboards can be added later as their own scoped change, priced from the same published ranges.

05.q: Do you work with early-stage companies?
05.a: Yes. Builds start from {minimumEngagement}, for companies that need custom work without product-level investment. For more complex systems, we phase the build so the investment matches the business stage.
